2116870621082562637.en_summary: Zambia's inflation came in at 6.3%/yr in October, within its target range of 6.0-8.0%/yr. After a long period of double-digit inflation, the Bank of Zambia has now hit its target for nine consecutive months.
2116870621082562637.zh_summary: 贊比亞10月通脹率為6.3%/年，處於其6.0-8.0%/年的目標範圍內。經過長期兩位數通脹後，贊比亞銀行現已連續九個月達到目標。

2116869778237264309.en_summary: (Reposted by @BillAckman) Embattled New York Attorney General Letitia James failed to probe three of the Big Apple’s most scandal-scarred homeless shelter operators while accepting more than $56,000 in campaign donations from their top executives, lobbyists and spouses over the past eight years. These are the kinds of abuses the AG is supposed to investigate, yet she has refused to hold them accountable, raising questions about whose interests she is protecting.
2116869778237264309.zh_summary: (由@BillAckman轉推) 處於困境的紐約總檢察長Letitia James未能調查紐約市三家最具醜聞的無家可歸者收容所運營商，同時在過去八年接受了他們的高層主管、遊說者和配偶超過56,000美元的競選捐款。這些正是總檢察長應該調查的濫用行為，但她拒絕追究責任，引發關於她保護誰的利益的疑問。
